'''The Sky's the Limit''' is the 15th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 26 April 2013. The set consists of 55 cards. This set is part of the ''The Next Generation Block'' consisting of cards from [[The Next Generation]], [[The Next Generation: Supplemental]], [[Engage]], [[The Sky's the Limit]], [[Coming of Age (expansion)|Coming of Age]], and [[Q Who? (expansion)|Q Who?]] virtual expansions.
